pillar_formula: pillar = 100 − mean |pct_earth − pct_target| over its comparable parameters
bareness is compared directly (same 0–1 scale on every world); all other parameters as percentile within their own planet
vegetation mask: C × clamp((0.30 − NDVI) / 0.10, 0, 1), so ground with NDVI above 0.30 scores 0

ml.note: Unsupervised, 80 places. Used to explore and to cross-check the formula; never part of the closeness score.
